payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterative DP over number of disks i from 1 to n, maintaining minimal cost for each (start, end) rod pair using standard Hanoi recurrence with two possible move sequences, choosing the cheaper one.
payload.rationale: The state is fundamentally indexed by the number of disks i, with only 6 rod-pair substates per i. The recurrence relies solely on i-1 states, typical of 1D DP; the rod dimension is a small constant, not a large varying second parameter.
